טבלה: שירותי דרך מורחבים
This table details the extended road service benefits provided to insured drivers following a road accident. It outlines the services covered, such as towing, transportation, and vehicle storage.
ממדים: Service provided as part of the extended road service coverage, Conditions and details of the service

Arrival of a representative on behalf of the service provider at the insured vehicle which was involved in a road accident, at the site of the accident in order to allow the insured to continue on his way and to continue the handling of the vehicle (subject to paragraph 8).
Driving the insured from the site of the accident , by means of the service provider's representative or taxi to the desired destination, at a distance of up to 250kms.
Continued handling of towing the vehicle to the desired destination.
Storing, guarding and towing the vehicle to the garage, if the service is provided at hours beyond the normal hours of activity.
All the services provided for the insured vehicle shall be provided in accordance with the service provider's 'road services and towing' service document and as noted therein.
The extended service will be provided across the State of Israel in areas under Israeli control, except for south of the Arava junction, east of Maaleh Adumim and in the Autonomy territories. Notwithstanding the aforementioned, the service will also be provided in Arad.
The extended service will only be provided if the Israel police is not involved, or in the alternative if the insured receives from the Israel police the authorizations required to execute the road services.
In order to avoid any doubt the services will be provided only from the site of the accident and not from police parking lots, storage lots in the service of the police, the insured 's home and garages.
Extended service will be provided to the insured within two hours of receipt of all the required call details by the service provider's computerized center, except for the following exclusions:
The day after holidays, Saturdays and sabbaticals.
Days during which  extreme weather conditions exist (heatwave, rain).
In areas outside cities, the service will be provided within two hours + the travelling time from the nearest town.
In occurrences emanating from force major and subject to traffic hazards and security limitations.
The extended service will only be provided if there is a need to tow the vehicle as a result of it being inoperable, as a result of a road accident, from the site of the accident and during the hours following the accident.
The extended service will be provided to the insured and whomsoever is in possession of the vehicle on his behalf and with his permission.
The insured will be entitled only to one extended service free of charge in respect of the same accident.
